artifact.name: vega_analysis_myc_densitometry_v1
artifact.label: Analysis: applies the standard curve to the raw lanes; produces the relative-protein Data
artifact.title: Densitometry: raw lane density to relative MYC protein
artifact.description: Converts the raw lane densities of the calibration and sample lanes into relative MYC protein, using the standard curve's fit and its stated treatment of out-of-range signal. Synthetic example.
artifact.procedure: The four calibration lanes of [the raw lane data](@vega_data_lane_traces_v1) were fit by the linear model of [the standard curve](@vega_model_myc_standard_curve_v1), tubulin-normalised density against loading fraction. The two sample lanes were read against that fit. The uninduced sample falls within the calibration range and is reported as a fitted value. The induced sample's tubulin-normalised MYC density falls below the 0.25x calibration point and is reported as below the assay floor, per the standard curve's stated treatment of out-of-range signal.
artifact.finding: Uninduced MYC protein at 0.94 of parental, within the calibration range. Induced MYC protein below the floor of 0.1 of parental at 72h.
